records.name: Enzyme assembly, coupled activity and channeling boundary
openObligations: This is a synthetic DNA-origami scaffold carrying commercially supplied enzymes, not a naturally evolved protein-only multienzyme complex, living metabolic network, protein biosynthesis or a cellular-origin experiment. The scaffold DNA is supplied; its sequence-dependent assembly was not independently reconstructed.

Negatively stained TEM, dye colocalization and photobleaching report different preparations/proxies. They support source-defined loading and location, not exact atom-level interfaces, universal pair occupancy, an impermeable shell or a measured protein-protein channel.

Photobleaching copy-number estimates normalize detected Cy3 steps to labels per free enzyme and depend on labeling, detection and six-state HMM assumptions. TableS3 covers HRP, G6pDH and beta-Gal, not direct proof that every cascade cage has exactly one GOx and one HRP.

Bulk cage concentration uses A260 and an adopted extinction coefficient0.109 nM^-1cm^-1; conjugate concentrations/labeling use absorbance deconvolution and inherited coefficients. Calibration, gel-extraction losses, active-enzyme fractions and labeling are not independently reproduced.

GOx/HRP activity is a coupled ABTS absorbance readout. It depends on both enzyme steps, intermediate availability, substrate concentrations and active fractions; it is not an isolated turnover count, direct intermediate trajectory, flux control coefficient or exclusive measure of substrate transfer.

The source nominally matches enzyme/cage concentrations but paired, separately caged and uncaged preparations differ in assembly, conjugation, purification, local environment and total cage/DNA organization. No isolated geometric confinement variable or equal active-site population is proven.

Separate full cages and half-cages also increase the coupled signal. Increased activity of a co-caged pair therefore does not uniquely establish direct substrate channeling, reduced intermediate escape or a proximity-only mechanism.

Hydration-layer ordering, electrostatic stabilization and conformational-substate mechanisms are proposed interpretations. Salt/helix-density comparisons alter more than one property and do not directly measure local water structure, local pH or a unique mechanism.

The single-molecule G6pDH enzymology uses a different enzyme, surface immobilization, PMS/resazurin reporter and 10 percent PEG. It is not the same GOx/HRP bulk cascade preparation or an independent replication of its fold enhancement.

The main/SI trypsin protocol annotations differ in digestion buffer, pH, enzyme concentration and assay ABTS concentration. No new protection/aggregation or persistence claim is admitted from those conflicting annotations.

No crosstalk suppression, competing-pathway insulation, local concentration gradient, intermediate residence/retention, synchronized feedback, closed metabolic cycle, sustained living-system regulation or universal efficiency benefit is measured in the admitted contexts.

The full main article and selected SI passages were read; most individual-enzyme kinetic traces and exact staple-sequence tables were not. Source ratios are approximate reported normalizations, not a new fit, digitization, data replay or independently reconstructed uncertainty.

records.name: Scoped chromatin-modification and response evidence
openObligations: Long-Evans rat hippocampus is bulk tissue containing neurons and glia. High/low licking-grooming and arched-back nursing groups are selected extremes of continuous maternal behavior, not universal biological classes.

Cross-fostering changes a postnatal care environment. It does not isolate licking from nursing, nutrition or other maternal effects, directly manipulate an abstract neural state, or establish germline inheritance. Same-class foster controls are other mothers, not untouched biological-mother controls.

General adult-age statements conflict with assay-specific 90-day descriptions. ChIP figures report four animals/group but supplementary fixed-tissue methods specify six. GR protein Figure 5a reports five but Western methods specify six. Clones and technical blot replicates are not independent animals; litter dependence remains relevant.

Exon 1_7 is an alternative first exon of the rat glucocorticoid receptor gene. CpG site 16 at the 5-prime end of the NGFI-A binding region and site 17 at its 3-prime end have different outcomes. Bisulfite cytosine readouts, acetyl-H3K9-associated ChIP, NGFI-A ChIP, GR protein and plasma corticosterone are separate observables.

TSA infusion is a broad pharmacological intervention, not a locus-specific methylation edit or cell-specific neural manipulation. The restraint-stress cohort is separate from the GR-protein cohort. Parallel effects do not identify their causal mediation order.

The published Figure 2-associated t/P pairs (2.1/P<0.001 and 3.1/P<0.0001) are inconsistent with ordinary t tests; exact uncertainty is not reproduced. The 27 July 2004 publisher correction fixes labels, corticosterone units to micrograms/dL and bisulfite PCR annealing to 56 degrees C; the supplement retains conflicting text.

Individual animal source values and clone sequences are unavailable in the reviewed materials. Published findings are not an independent reproduction, and nonsignificant contrasts are not equivalence tests.

Methylation, histone-associated ChIP, factor-associated ChIP, protein immunoreactivity and endocrine responses are different observables. Cross-fostering and broad TSA perturbations do not isolate a unique causal histone/methylation mediator or universal histone code.

Cross-sectional developmental cohorts and adult observations do not establish mitotic or transgenerational chromatin inheritance, continuous persistence in the same cell, lineage stabilization, universal contextual memory or long-range coordinated regulation.

No genome-wide sequence comparison proves absence of all sequence variation. The epigenetic interpretation is bounded by the actual locus assays and environmental/drug contrasts, rather than universal sequence-independent regulation of replication and transcription.

Replication/transcription, protein cooperativity, signalling and hydrogen-bond studies are separate original parent scopes. They are not jointly measured necessary mediators or calibrated contributions to the selected hippocampal outcomes.

Source catalogue level, phase, role, science/status and requirement labels are representation choices. Original parent weights, necessity, directions/modes, carrier minima/critical counts and null saturation are not measured causal fractions, physical thresholds or a universal construction sequence. Generic evidence placeholders add no unidentified study or independent replication.
